name: Just Egg
description: A blended mung bean batter that cooks up light and eggy — perfect for omelets, scrambles, and breakfast burritos in about 5 minutes.

ingredients.item: dry yellow split mung beans (moong dal), soaked overnight
ingredients.note: Soak in cold water overnight, then drain before blending
Optional — gives an eggy sulphur flavour

steps: Soak the mung beans in plenty of cold water overnight (at least 8 hours), then drain well.
Add the drained beans to a blender with the nondairy milk, oil, nutritional yeast, baking powder, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, pepper, and kala namak if using. Blend until completely smooth.
Transfer to a glass jar or airtight container and refrigerate — keeps for up to one week.
To cook an omelet: lightly oil a non-stick pan and set over medium-high heat. Pour in about 120 ml (½ cup) of batter and tilt to spread into a thin circle.
Cook until the edges set and bubbles appear across the surface, then flip and cook the other side for a minute until lightly golden.
notes: For sweet dishes like French toast, omit the garlic and onion powder. Cook the batter before freezing — it stores better than the raw mix. Watch the heat; lower it if the batter sticks.
